subject: Error deploying shiny app with shinyjs package

messages.author: 72c2c95714f0a9bb
messages.subject: Error deploying shiny app with shinyjs package
parts:
Hi all,

I am getting the following error:

Attaching package: ‘shinyjs’ The following object is masked from ‘package:shiny’: runExample The following objects are masked from ‘package:methods’: removeClass, show 

I am using just one function of the package shinyjs ---> shinyjs::toggle(). I already specified the package behind the function and tried to deploy the app with the command rsconnect::deployApp() but without success,

Could you please assist?

Thanks

messages.author: fd2fc7e46319d1dd
messages.subject: Re: Error deploying shiny app with shinyjs package
parts:
Hi,

I don't think the problem is linked to the "shinyjs" package. The message is just saying that there is a function called "runExample()" in the "shinyjs" package which will overwrite the "runExample()" function in the "shiny" package.

Do you have any other message / info about the error or what could have been wrong ?


Best regards,


A.D.
